finalText:
Builds clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). Two real bugs from the dependency bump, both in the link stage — the rest of the "screen full of warnings" was just deprecation noise:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries`, which was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`; `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled).

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation notices from the bumped packages (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()` constructor, sync loader hook, `punycode`, `module.parent`, plus three lint-style ones) — not build-breaking, worth a look eventually but not urgent.
